The procedure for addressing the J-Tracks so as to the resolve the issue whether 
business or technical is an efficient manner will be as follows: 
(i) 
The Helpdesk will register the issues raised by the field offices and will allot a J-Track 
ID. During registration the module to which the issue pertains will be marked by the 
I helpdesk. 
(ii) 
The I-Track will then be available to the DPAs reporting to DD (IS) to whom the 
I particular module work is earmarked. 
I 
If the issue needs a technical solution then the issue will be taken up with the 
I 
coding team. I f the solution can be provided immediately the same will be 
provided. Otherwise the issues will be taken up with the NIC. The solution will be 
tested and deployed thereafter. If resolved the same will be marked in the system. 
If the issue needs a business solution then the issue will be forwarded to the 
Project Division at headquarters. 
(iii) 
I n Project Division if the solution to the issues can be provided immediately the same 
will be provided. Otherwise the issues will be taken up with the Concerned Divisions 
at headquarters. 
2.

submiped to the Addl. CPFC (IS).
